Shaphan_1: scribe of King Josiah (2 Kings 22:3, 2 Chronicles 34:15)
Jehoiachin_1: King of Judah, son of Eliakim [Jehoiakim] (2 Kings 24:6)
Mattaniah_1: King of Judah, uncle of Jehoiachin (2 Kings 24:17)
Nebuzaradan_1: captain of the guard of the King of Babylon (2 Kings 25:8) who took captives into exile (Jeremiah 39:9)
Seraiah_2: the chief priest (2 Kings 25:18) who was killed by the king of Babylon (2 Kings 25:21)
Zephaniah_1: the second-in-charge priest (2 Kings 25:18) who was killed by the king of Babylon (2 Kings 25:21)
Gedaliah_1: son of Ahikam, appointed King of Judah by Nebuchadnezzar (2 Kings 25:22)
Ishmael_2: son of Nethaniah, a captain of Judean forces during the Babylonian captivity (2 Kings 25:23)
Nethaniah_1: father of Ishmael, one of the captains of Judean forces (2 Kings 25:23)
Johanan_1: son of Kareah, a captain of Judean forces during the Babylonian captivity (2 Kings 25:23)
Kareah_1: father of Johanan, one of the captains of Judean forces (2 Kings 25:23)
Seraiah_3: son of Tanhumeth, a captain of Judean forces during the Babylonian captivity (2 Kings 25:23)
Tanhumeth_1: the Netophathite, father of Seraiah, one of the captains of Judean forces (2 Kings 25:23)
Jaazaniah_1: son of the Maacathite, a captain of Judean forces during the Babylonian captivity (2 Kings 25:23)
Hoshaiah_2: father of Jezaniah [Jaazaniah_1] (Jeremiah 42:1) and a Maacathite (2 Kings 25:23, Jeremiah 40:8)
